name: defi.money
oneLiner: MONEY is defi.money's crvUSD-style stablecoin minted against overcollateralized loans of WBTC, ETH, and other approved collateral on Arbitrum and Optimism.
collateral: Overcollateralized loan collateral accepted by defi.money markets on supported networks, including assets such as WBTC and ETH rather than a fixed USDC reserve portfolio
pegMechanism: crvUSD-style loan/CDP stablecoin: users deposit approved collateral, borrow MONEY against protocol risk parameters and conversion ranges, and maintain solvency through market-specific liquidation and peg-keeper mechanics

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from Pharos stablecoin metadata by the blacklistability resolver through parent, reserve, custody, variant, or text-signal exposure; no separate manual override source is attached.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Inferred review retained: MONEY resolves to Upstream because existing dependency, reserve, custody, variant, or text metadata links exposure to a freezable upstream asset.

mintAuthority.summary: MONEY is an authorized crvUSD fork on Arbitrum/Optimism: users deposit approved collateral (WBTC, ETH, etc.) and mint MONEY against per-market debt ceilings using crvUSD's controller/LLAMMA design; defi.money governance/admin controls market onboarding and risk parameters.

controls.label: defi.money market controllers (crvUSD-style minter)
controls.capDescription: MONEY is minted only against overcollateralized loans in defi.money markets under per-market debt ceilings, using crvUSD's controller and LLAMMA soft-liquidation mechanics; supply tracks collateralized borrowing, not an issuer minter.
controls.evidence: defi.money docs describe a crvUSD-style loan/CDP stablecoin where users deposit approved collateral and borrow MONEY against per-market risk parameters with peg-keeper/LLAMMA mechanics.

controls.label: defi.money governance / admin
controls.capDescription: defi.money governance/admin (analogous to Curve's admin and emergency-DAO layer) onboards markets, sets debt ceilings and risk parameters, and can authorize new minting markets.
controls.evidence: As an authorized crvUSD fork, defi.money carries a Curve-style admin/emergency-control layer that adds markets and tunes parameters; the specific multisig signers/threshold were not resolved.

review.evidence: defi.money documentation and coverage confirm MONEY is an authorized crvUSD fork using LLAMMA, minted against overcollateralized loans with governance/admin control over markets and parameters; no centralized issuer mint exists.
review.sourceFreeRationale: crvUSD-fork mint mechanism confirmed from defi.money docs/coverage; the admin multisig/emergency-DAO signers, threshold, and per-market controllers were not independently read on-chain.
unresolvedQuestions: Resolve the defi.money admin/emergency multisig (signers, threshold) and the per-market controller/factory authority before raising confidence.
